notes.subject: jukɔrɔlenw
notes.rationale: יתר: 'tent-cord' (ASV/JPS) vs 'excellency/dignity' (KJV/Geneva) — cord-pulling picture fits the tent imagery of v.20

notes.subject: dɔnniya
notes.rationale: חכמה rendered dɔnniya (wisdom/knowledge); the point is they die without understanding

notes.subject: u tɛ sa ni dɔnniya ye
notes.rationale: second reading: 'they die, and not in wisdom' — the Hebrew lets both a statement and a consequence stand

translation: Yala u ka jukɔrɔlenw ma bɔ u kɔnɔ wa? U bɛ sa, ka tɛ ni dɔnniya ye.
